correctness.rationale: The exact derivatives are |f_p'(x)|=|x|^(p-1) and f_p''(x)=(p-1)|x|^(p-2). For p=3, Strategy 4.1 yields the three exact factors by comparing the Newton step with the selected radius. For p>3, f_p''/sqrt(|f_p'|) tends to zero, the middle branch applies, and the unconstrained step divided by the radius tends to 4, so the boundary is active. With s=(p-3)/2, the exact recurrence implies |x_{k+1}|^(-s)-|x_k|^(-s) tends to s/(4 rho_min), proving the stated asymptotic. The local acceptance ratios exceed eta (or the gradient ratio is 1/4<xi), so the parameter floor is reached after finitely many iterations.
